title: 5.5-round AES-192: Related-key impossible inner-round transition

target.description: The source calls this a5.5-round interval: enter immediately after MixColumns of round1, apply AddRoundKey1 and rounds2–6 with their inner MixColumns, and exit after AddRoundKey6. It is not a6-round plaintext-to-ciphertext attack.

setting.key_relation: Two unknown AES-192 master keys K and K'=K XOR Delta, where Delta[0]=Delta[8]=a!=0 and the other22 bytes are0. Initial whitening is k0; round subkeys are k1,... .
setting.key_population: General unknown key pair with attacker-chosen nonzero a; b,c are actual key-dependent S-box output differences, not independently chosen subkeys.
setting.plaintext_model: Input internal-state difference x1^M has(a,0,0,0) in columns2 and3 and zeros elsewhere.

evidence.locator: Printed pp.18–19 Section3, impossible transition and forward/backward proof
evidence.interpretation: Complete original proceedings reviewed. Source-convention boundaries, total queries across the two keys, partial output and native accounting are kept explicit.

limitations: Independent local checks cover the AES key schedule and deterministic components. Full cryptanalytic searches, resource calibration and success rates have not been reproduced.

property.statement: The specified internal input difference cannot yield an x6^O difference whose last column is(0,0,0,b), with the first three output columns unrestricted.
property.quantifier: For every pair of internal states and every standard AES-192 related-key pair satisfying Table2 and the specified input difference.
property.scope: The forward path forces x5^O byte1 difference nonzero. Reversing the proposed last-column output through ARK6/MC6/SR6 forces that same byte difference zero.

parameters.name: Source interval
parameters.meaning: From after MC1 through ARK6; exact entry/exit stages define the count.

parameters.name: Transition probability
parameters.meaning: Deterministic contradiction under the stated related-key schedule.

parameters.name: Unrestricted output coordinates
parameters.meaning: Only the last output column is fixed to(0,0,0,b).

validation.description: Symbolic nonzero/zero propagation in Section3.512 independent forward component examples and512 backward target-column checks agree.
